title: Samsung Display Diamond Pixel OLED subpixel distribution
copyright: Samsung Display; source attribution retained for this local research report.
resampling: none during field expansion; source tile retains its original BOX resampling
intensity_model: Original green channel only, sRGB-decoded to linear green intensity at 530 nm; R/B zero. Image is an illustrative emitter proxy, not calibrated panel radiometry.
scale_note: Original 2um/texel example assumption retained, not measured panel calibration. Increasing the field changes tile count, not emitter dimensions or spacing.
crop_selection: Minimize boundary RGB energy plus opposite-edge neighbor jump at the detected periods

source_tile_provenance.title: Samsung Display Diamond Pixel OLED subpixel distribution
source_tile_provenance.copyright: Samsung Display; source attribution retained for this local research report.
source_tile_provenance.intensity_model: sRGB decoded to linear RGB, then photopic luma weights 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722; single effective wavelength 530nm
source_tile_provenance.scale_note: Physical scale is an explicit example assumption; web illustration is not a radiometrically calibrated panel measurement.

expansion_method: crop one complete repeat cell, integer tile, then top-left field crop; no resizing or interpolation
tile_boundary_note: One 70x70 repeat cell is cropped before tiling. Wrap-neighbor jumps are smaller than ordinary within-cell neighbor variation in both axes. No seam blending, pixel repainting or procedural emitter reconstruction is applied.
processing: G unchanged byte for byte; R=B=0; no resizing, repainting, edge blending or lattice changes
green_subcell_caveat: The four green footprints within the full supercell are not identical. The exact intensity repeat is 140 um, not 70 um.
